result_1.boundary: This is established causal-inference mathematics applied as a protocol gate; not claimed as new mathematics.
result_1.converse_boundary: D-connection means structural independence is not certified, not that actual leakage is guaranteed.
result_1.name: JANUS Causal Isolation / D-Separation Gate
result_1.statement: In a correctly specified Markovian causal DAG, if hard target secret T is d-separated from hard PRE_RETURN view R conditional on allowed public metadata M, then T is conditionally independent of R given M. Therefore observing R does not improve optimal classical guessing probability beyond M: p_guess(T|R,M)=p_guess(T|M), equivalently H_min(T|R,M)=H_min(T|M).

result_2.counterexample: shared_seed_state -> T and shared_seed_state -> seed_exposure -> R
result_2.interpretation: A common latent cause can destroy independence without any directed future-to-past information path.
result_2.name: Directed-path-only criterion falsified

result_3.construction: T and R independent; selected_for_analysis is a child of both.
result_3.interpretation: Post-selection/reporting can manufacture perfect apparent dependence from independent variables.
result_3.name: Selection collider warning

result_5.name: Target-derived precommit side-information warning
result_5.protocol_rule: No target pre-generation, target-derived commitment, prefetch or side information may enter PRE_RETURN hard view before the freeze.
result_5.toy_demo: For an 8-bit uniform target, revealing one target-derived bit before freeze raises p_guess from 1/256 to 1/128 and lowers min-entropy from 8 to 7 bits.
